method: Five separate Python subprocesses use the same SQLite file: enqueue -> claim -> intentional process exit -> cannot reclaim before lease -> reclaim after lease -> persist READY -> readback in a fresh process. Only synthetic records; no GitHub network and no payment.
not_verified: machine power loss or whole-host restart
durability across Render deployments or ephemeral filesystems
payment authenticity in a real Stripe environment
real worker scheduling, customer delivery or independent verification of external receipts
exact-head committee approval, merge and deployment
verified_claim: same-version local SQLite survives process exit and supports lease-bound recovery without duplicate claim while lease is valid
